title: Import a project JSON
description: Choose a project file to review it before replacing your current profile.
privacy: Only JSON files with this generator’s supported project structure can be imported. Files are read on this device; your current profile stays unchanged until you confirm replacement.
openHelp: Choose a project JSON previously saved by this generator. Arbitrary JSON and GitHub profile or API exports are not compatible.
fileHelp: Choose a UTF-8 project JSON file, up to {limit} MiB. It must use this generator’s supported project structure; it is read locally and never uploaded.
reviewReady: Project opened for review. Your current profile has not changed.
reviewHelp: Check the content language, sections and their visibility. Opening replaces the whole profile, including hidden content; it does not merge projects.
reviewInert: This summary keeps external content inactive. Your text and settings are preserved, including unfinished content you can correct later.
migrated: This file uses an earlier project format. It has been updated in memory for review; the original file has not changed. Future downloads will use the current format.
confirmHelp: Replace your current profile with the reviewed project? This includes sections you have hidden.
confirmLabel: I have reviewed the project and want to replace my current profile.
restoreHelp: Restore the profile from before the last project you opened? This replaces your current work, including hidden sections. Download your current project first if you want to keep it. The recovery copy will remain available.
restoreLabel: I want to replace my current profile with this recovery copy.

backup.title: Before the last opened project
backup.available: A copy of the profile you had before opening your last project is available. There is one recovery copy, not a history.
backup.invalid: An existing recovery record could not be validated. It will be kept untouched. Opening can continue only in memory if a safe backup cannot be saved.
backup.unavailable: The browser recovery record could not be accessed. Opening can continue only in memory if a safe backup cannot be saved.
backup.independent: This recovery copy is separate from the backup and original Markdown kept by the README importer.
backup.beforeReplace: Before replacement, the generator will try to save a complete recovery copy of your current profile in this browser. If storage fails, you will decide whether to continue only in memory.
backup.replace: This will replace the recovery copy from the last opened project. Download that copy first if you want to keep it. Your Markdown import backup is kept separately.

memory.title: Your work could not be saved safely
memory.help: The backup or profile could not be saved, or browser storage is protected. You can keep editing in this tab with automatic saving paused. Reloading or closing may bring back the previously saved profile. A recovery copy may already be available.
memory.saveFirst: Download a copy of your current profile before continuing. You can export the opened project from the editor afterward.

summary.presentation: {count, plural, one {# completed field} other {# completed fields}}
summary.technologies: {count, plural, one {# tool} other {# tools}} in {groups, plural, one {# category} other {# categories}}
summary.contributions: {count, plural, one {# contribution} other {# contributions}} · {cards, plural, one {# selected GitHub card} other {# selected GitHub cards}}
summary.preserved: Your complete project is preserved, including hidden content and unfinished fields. This summary does not remove any content.

errors.file_type: Choose a project file ending in .json.
errors.too_large: This project is too large. Choose a file no larger than {limit} MiB.
errors.encoding: This file could not be read as UTF-8 text. Save it as UTF-8 and try again.
errors.read: The file could not be opened. Choose it again or try another file.
errors.invalid_json: This file is not valid JSON. Choose a complete project downloaded from this generator.
errors.invalid_document: This file is not a supported project, contains incompatible properties or exceeds the allowed complexity. Your current profile is unchanged. Keep the original file and try a compatible copy.
errors.unsupported_version: This project uses an unsupported format version. Your current profile is unchanged. Keep the file and open it with a compatible version of the generator.
errors.download_too_large: This project exceeds the 4 MiB file limit and could not be downloaded. Your current work is unchanged.
errors.download_invalid: A compatible project file could not be created from this draft. Your current work is unchanged.
errors.download: The project could not be downloaded. Your current work is unchanged; try again.
errors.not_ready: Your draft is still loading. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.operation_invalid: The project could not be applied safely. Return to review or choose the file again.
errors.current_too_large: Your current profile exceeds the 4 MiB limit for a complete recovery copy. Reduce its content before opening another project. Your work is kept.
errors.current_invalid: A compatible recovery copy of your current profile could not be created. Review its content before opening another project. Your work is kept.
